note: This increment adds Section Map budget and GSI/PSI independence tests. The public-symbol parser is unchanged.
covered: public fallback is used only when the DBI ArePrivateSymbolsStripped flag is set
the DBI SymRecordStream GSS is scanned for S_PUB32 without reading GSI or PSI hash tables
cvpsfFunction records preserve their emitted name and map the one-based segment and offset through the DBI Section Map to an executable PE section
selector, absolute-address and group descriptors are rejected
each public range ends at the next distinct public function in the mapped section or at the descriptor boundary
exact module procedures and source lines win over the public fallback
the 64MiB file, 1000000 record, 200000 public function, 512 Section Map descriptor and 4096-byte name bounds are enforced
record framing, F1/F2/F3 alignment bytes, section references and range arithmetic are validated
malformed public PDBs contribute no partial symbols
limits: No final image, public CI or external SDK crash was exercised in this increment.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
